title: Viral RNA Isolation (Magnetic Beads)
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather robot, modules, and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect an Opentrons OT‑2 robot, magnetic module GEN2, temperature module GEN2, a 384‑well plate (Cole Parmer, 50 µL capacity) mounted on the temperature module, a 96‑deepwell plate (USA Scientific, 2.4 mL, catalog #1896‑2000), a 12‑well reservoir (USA Scientific, 22 mL), Opentrons P300 GEN2 multi‑channel pipette, Opentrons P20 GEN2 single‑channel pipette, and 20 µL and 200 µL filter tips.

steps.title: Define protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the desired parameters for the automated 3‑wash viral RNA isolation using magnetic beads (e.g., wash volumes, elution volume) into the protocol builder.

steps.title: Generate and download protocol
steps.instruction: Click the button to generate the Python protocol script and download the resulting file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT App, navigate to the protocol upload section, and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the magnetic module GEN2, temperature module GEN2 with the 384‑well plate, the 96‑deepwell plate, the 12‑well reservoir, and tip racks on the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for all labware, tip racks, and both pipettes (P300 GEN2 multi‑channel and P20 GEN2 single‑channel). Follow the on‑screen prompts and reference the support articles if needed.

steps.title: Execute the RNA isolation
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated 3‑wash magnetic‑bead viral RNA isolation; the robot will perform washes, bind RNA to beads, and finally transfer purified elutions to the 384‑well plate on the temperature module GEN2.
